column3: BSB’s “their children” matches the Textus Receptus (αὐτῶν); “become Your Father” replaces “begotten You.”
“Promised” and “blessings” supply the referent of the holy and sure things.
“His body was buried” replaces he was added to his fathers.
BSB’s “to you” matches the Textus Receptus (ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς); the critical text lacks it.

BSB supplies “Paul and Barnabas,” “the synagogue,” and “the people”; the critical text says only “as they were going out, they begged.” The Textus Receptus has “the Jews … from the synagogue” and “the Gentiles” (ἔθνη).
